title: Bread in the Meadow
lines: Sam wanted to have lunch in the green meadow.
Dad said yes, so they packed a big bag.
Sam set the fresh bread in it. Dad had a jug.
The bag was heavy. Sam had to tug it.
The weather was hot, and his head was wet with sweat.
They spread a red rug on the grass.
Dad cut the bread into thick bits.
A big black crow sat up in the tree.
It looked at them and did not go.
Then it flew low and left a feather.
It took the bread and went back up the tree!
Sam ran after it, but the crow flew off.
"We have no lunch," said Dad. Sam sat.
Then Sam looked at the heavy bag again.
Why was it heavy with no bread in it?
He got it and looked in. Dad had packed more!
There was a second loaf and some plums.
They ate in the meadow, and the crow ate too.

questions.ask: What did the crow leave, and what did it take?
questions.listenFor: It left a feather and took the bread. Listen for both.

questions.ask: Why was the bag so heavy?
questions.listenFor: Dad had packed a second loaf and plums. Have them find that line.

questions.ask: What would you have said to that crow? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any idea is fine if it fits the story. Listen for a reason.
